description: This file defines a parser for the PHC string format, including data structures, token definitions, and parsing logic for interpreting PHC strings.

classes.name: PHC
classes.description: Represents a parsed PHC string with fields for identifier, version, parameters, salt, and hash.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A parser that reads and interprets PHC strings from an input stream.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new Parser instance with input limited to MaxRunes runes.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a single rune from the input stream.

methods.name: scan
methods.description: Scans for an identifier or separator token based on allowed characters.

methods.name: scanIdent
methods.description: Scans a sequence of allowed runes forming an identifier.

methods.name: parseToken
methods.description: Parses a specific token expected in the input stream.

methods.name: parseFunctionId
methods.description: Parses a function identifier starting with '$'.

methods.name: parseHash
methods.description: Parses a base64-encoded hash and ensures it is at the end of the input.

methods.name: parseParamRHS
methods.description: Parses an '=' followed by a parameter value.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Main function to parse the input stream into a PHC object.
